resolvedQuestions.decision: Adopt a purpose-bound, disposable BeliefProjectionV1 over verified events; only non-stale IN premises are usable, and control use requires checked quiescence plus selected 036 authority state and epoch.
whenNotToUse: surfaces already decided by existing evidence signals

resolvedQuestions.decision: Use reference-closed independent domain and audit cuts, exact-version or registered no-op reduction, and disposable verified checkpoints; never compact committed authority history.
whenNotToUse: unknown event, upcaster, reducer, audit-closure, or canonicalizer identity

resolvedQuestions.decision: Compare authorized causal operation prefixes with independent checkpoints, closed normalization, proven partial orders, and manifest-bound mutants; refused prefixes prove zero domain, budget, and effect mutation plus one linked audit denial.
whenNotToUse: local units with stronger direct oracles

resolvedQuestions.decision: Every protected mutation is claimant-addressed and target-complete; claim, authority epoch, idempotency, all fences, all expected versions or heads, and transition rules are revalidated atomically at commit.
whenNotToUse: immutable content-addressed writes without replacement, append, alias, debit, or external-effect races

resolvedQuestions.decision: Order semantic supersession by observedAt plus authorizedSequence while replay stays ledger ordered; preview all truth-affecting candidates against one clean base and commit only after prospective fixed-point, successor, cycle, and nogood checks under one serializable belief-admission fence/version.
whenNotToUse: static invariants handled by simpler transactions

resolvedQuestions.decision: TransitionRefusalV1 is a versioned authority-none operation outcome linked to the durable audit denial; it is never an event, command, capability, allow proof, effect, or executable repair, and every suggestion requires a fresh authorized request.
whenNotToUse: local parser/input errors without a gateway decision
transports with an already-complete bounded typed error

resolvedQuestions.decision: A durable human gate binds exact topology, evidence, belief, principal, capability, version, fence, expiry, timeout, and semantic dependencies; consequence append revalidates all of them, and external effect authorization remains separate.
whenNotToUse: interactions without consequence-bearing edges, mutations, budget changes, or effects

keyFindings.finding: Repo 1 remains the controlling architecture; Graphene contributes seven concrete mechanisms and counterexamples but no replacement authority plane.
Only the governed per-mode 036 authority state and epoch select a control owner; projections, parity, checkpoints, refusals, alerts, and human choices cannot become authority by interpretation.
Graphene's four-valued belief model is useful only with purpose/source identity, checked termination, prospective admission, and authority-disposition guards.
Fold-equivalent projection bytes do not justify deleting committed authority history because authorization, audit, replay, and historical reads observe more than final state.
Terminal parity is insufficient; an adapter can reach the same final state through an unauthorized, reordered, refused-but-mutating, or budget/effect-divergent prefix.
Worktree or lease isolation is not mutation authority; stale-successor safety exists only when the protected store atomically validates the current fence and expected state during the mutation.

keyFindings.finding: Semantic observation order and deterministic replay order are distinct; merging them into timestamp order or one synthetic domain/audit sequence destroys evidence.
Refusal advice and human choices are context-bearing outcomes, not capabilities; both must enter a fresh gateway decision before any consequence or effect.
The remaining frontier is executable and measured evidence, not another document pass; absence of promotion evidence does not reopen the settled research decisions.

ruledOutDirections.approach: Unified Graphene authority stack or graph-wide kill switch
ruledOutDirections.reason: Projection, parity, writer, truth, human, and effect risks have different reversible boundaries.
Projection equivalence does not preserve immutable audit, authorization, replay, or point-in-time evidence.

ruledOutDirections.approach: Timestamp replay order or a synthetic domain/audit sequence
ruledOutDirections.reason: Semantic observation order, domain ledger order, and audit ledger order are distinct contracts.

ruledOutDirections.approach: Projection freshness, terminal parity, repeat-green, checkpoint validity, or transport success as authority
ruledOutDirections.reason: Only the 036 authority state and epoch select the writer or control owner.

ruledOutDirections.approach: Node-only completion, preflight-only fences, or wave/lease admission as commit authority
ruledOutDirections.reason: Stale successors are rejected only by claimant-addressed commit-time fence and expected-state validation.

ruledOutDirections.approach: Post-admission nogood detection or last-write-wins supersession
ruledOutDirections.reason: Truth candidates must preserve temporal semantics and pass prospective closure before append.

ruledOutDirections.approach: Executable refusal advice, implicit approval, or human choice as effect authority
ruledOutDirections.reason: Advice and choice have no authority; consequences and effects require fresh independent authorization.

ruledOutDirections.approach: Apply P1-P7 wholesale to simple or non-consequential surfaces
ruledOutDirections.reason: Direct transforms, cheap replay, immutable reads, local errors, and acknowledgements gain no matching safety benefit.
